{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Field Procedure|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Zacariah Nemo — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Zacariah Nemo]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Zacariah Nemo]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Zacariah Nemo]]'s Engineer services at Nemo Cyber Party Base in Yoru.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Zacariah Nemo is discovered through [[Elvira Martuuk]].
* '''Invitation:''' Gain an '''invitation from the Party of Yoru'''.
* Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Elvira Martuuk]].
* Reach at least '''Friendly reputation''' with the Party of Yoru.
* Obtain the Party of Yoru Engineer invitation.
* Obtain '''25 units of Xihe Biomorphic Companions'''.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining Xihe Biomorphic Companions'''
The normal production source for Xihe Biomorphic Companions is:

* '''System:''' Xihe
* '''Station:''' Zhen Dock
* '''Commodity type:''' Rare commodity

Nemo requires '''25 units''' in total.

Because Xihe Biomorphic Companions are a rare commodity, Zhen Dock offers a limited allocation rather than the large market supply normally associated with ordinary commodities.

The available quantity can vary, so check the current allocation when preparing the unlock rather than planning around a fixed number from an older guide.

{{Tip|Nemo only requires 25 units, but the available rare-good allocation may still be lower than the full requirement. If that happens, additional purchases may be necessary.}}

Player-owned [[Fleet Carrier|Fleet Carriers]] may also offer Xihe Biomorphic Companions if another Commander has stocked them for resale. Carrier availability and prices are player-controlled and can change.

{{Field note|Xihe Biomorphic Companions have legal restrictions in some jurisdictions. If transporting them somewhere other than Yoru, check whether the commodity is legal in the destination system.}}

See Xihe Biomorphic Companions for current acquisition details and Rare Commodities for how rare-good allocations work.

{{Field note|Current Engineer data notes that station services may not become available immediately after Nemo is unlocked. If the workshop or other expected services do not appear after completing the unlock, logging out and back in may make them available.}}

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Elvira Martuuk]].
# Receive Elvira's referral to Zacariah Nemo.
# Reach at least '''Friendly reputation''' with the Party of Yoru.
# Obtain the Party of Yoru Engineer invitation.
# Obtain '''25 units of Xihe Biomorphic Companions'''.
# Travel to '''Nemo Cyber Party Base''' on '''Yoru 4'''.
# Donate the 25 Xihe Biomorphic Companions to Zacariah Nemo.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with Nemo.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Zacariah Nemo]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
